$comment: Deterministic build-time feedback loop (the treatment). Disabled condition runs none of this. See methodology.md section 5.
trigger: each time an implement, fix, or sensor-repair stage returns with checkCondition == on

suites.purpose: server and worker start; health endpoint responds
disclosed examples for submission, validation, completion, retry, idempotency

suitesLocation: identical copies under checks/ in the starting repository for BOTH conditions (read-only to the model, so either condition may run them as a native self-check); the runner executes its own protected copy from outside the workspace, so edits to the workspace copy cannot change feedback
feedbackContents: suite id and check name for each failure, in suite order
expected vs observed status code / field, using only disclosed example data
last 40 lines of server and worker stderr, secrets-scrubbed
remaining sensor repairs and remaining stage minutes
feedbackExcludes: independent evaluator cases, fixtures, verdicts, or source
truncation: whole message truncated at limits.handoff.sensorFeedbackMaxBytes with an explicit [truncated] marker
stopRule: stop when all suites pass, when maxPerWorkflow repairs are used, or when the owning stage ceiling is reached

implementation.modelVisibleSuites: fixtures/scaffold/checks/ (core.ts, smoke.ts, contract.ts, cli.ts), run with node --experimental-strip-types; --report <file> writes job-tracker/check-report@1 JSON
implementation.runner: src/feedback/checks.ts: copies the workspace with the evaluator snapshot rules, restores protected fixed files and checks/, runs build then smoke then contract in the OS sandbox under one ceiling
implementation.record: harness-benchmark/check-run@1 per check run, plus a repair event carrying the exact feedback text and its byte count

gate.intermediate: failing checks with no repairs or no stage time left: continue to the scheduled review
gate.final: failing checks with no repairs left: repair-budget-exhausted; with repairs left but no stage time: stage-timeout
gate.workflowCeiling: failing checks at the workflow ceiling: task-timeout
